# @tansy/theme-magazine

A magazine look for the blog plugin: a hero with search, image cards, and a sidebar of featured and latest posts.

```bash
npm install @tansy/theme-magazine
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the magazine theme documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/themes/magazine.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party theme for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
